title: Harden utilization configuration retention, invalid-snapshot diagnostics and refresh-cap fixture isolation
outcome: Address the three nonblocking utilization findings from the batch-2 v2 Sonnet review while preserving the cached observation-only contract.
acceptance: Sampler retains the last valid configuration when StateInner is temporarily busy rather than skipping every native metric sample.
Peer snapshot validation failures use an appropriate bounded diagnostic distinct from host identity mismatch.
The refresh-cap test uses an inert scripted sampler and continues to verify the authenticated concurrency cap.
